name: Sharakim
traits: Medium Humanoid with the Human subtype. Strength +2, Dexterity −2, Intelligence +2, Charisma −2. Base land speed 30 ft.
Darkvision 60 ft. in black and white. +1 natural armor bonus to AC.
Shadow Affinity (Ex) gives +2 racial bonus to Hide, Move Silently, Search, and Spot in darkness or shadowy illumination.
Light Sensitivity (Ex) gives −1 on attack rolls in bright sunlight or within a daylight spell. Its penalty applies to attack rolls only.
+1 racial bonus on attack rolls against orcs and half-orcs. The bonus and the light penalty both apply if both conditions are present.
Common is automatic. Bonus languages Dwarven, Elven, Gnome, and Orc. Favored class Wizard. Level adjustment +1.
